name: Flexion
description: Bending that decreases the angle between body parts.

name: Extension
description: Straightening that increases the angle between body parts.

name: Abduction
description: Movement away from the midline of the body.

name: Adduction
description: Movement toward the midline of the body.

name: Internal rotation
description: Rotation of a limb or body part toward the midline.

name: External rotation
description: Rotation of a limb or body part away from the midline.

name: Horizontal abduction
description: Movement of the arm away from the midline in a horizontal plane.

name: Horizontal adduction
description: Movement of the arm toward the midline in a horizontal plane.

name: Dorsiflexion
description: Movement that brings the top of the foot closer to the shin.

name: Plantarflexion
description: Movement that points the foot downward, away from the shin.

name: Inversion
description: Turning the sole of the foot inward.

name: Eversion
description: Turning the sole of the foot outward.

name: Lateral flexion
description: Bending of the trunk or neck to the side.

name: Rotation
description: Turning around the body’s vertical axis.

name: Posterior tilt
description: Tilting the pelvis backward, flattening the lower back.

name: Anterior tilt
description: Tilting the pelvis forward, increasing the lower back curve.

name: Decrease lumbar lordosis
description: Reduction of the natural inward curve of the lower spine.

name: Increase lumbar lordosis
description: Increase of the natural inward curve of the lower spine.
